verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Entra handles SAML- and OIDC-enabled applications for SSO, but only in the context of requesting gallery listing via the application network portal (docs-15). It also shows general application management covering tokens and certificates (docs-16). Nothing documents configuring non-gallery or custom apps directly, and nothing covers header-based SSO. Missing for 10: documented walkthrough for custom non-gallery SAML app SSO, custom OIDC app registration walkthrough, header-based SSO support, independent or hands-on corroboration.
